y-m-67-09.material: Two students solve indefinite integral ∫x ln x dx (x>0; read 'integral of x times natural logarithm of x, dx') using ∫u v′ dx=uv−∫u′v dx. Jihu chooses u=ln x, v′=x; Haeun chooses u=x, v′=ln x. (Assume you know ∫ln x dx=x ln x−x. Integration constant C.)

y-m-67-09.s.s1.r.b: You only look at simple u′, no consider work to find v (integral ln x).
